companyInfo.name: Kforce
companyInfo.description: Kforce has a client that is seeking a UI/UX Developer in Madison, WI. Overview: In brief, we a handful of AI-powered tools for our workforce which could use a facelift to improve the overall user experience. In an ideal scenario, we would love to bring on someone that has the skills to work directly in our codebases (engineering skills) while they make improvements to the UI/UX based on their knowledge of best practices. We currently have three tools that users are interacting with; one is an Edge browser extension (JavaScript), one is using Streamlit web application (python currently but we'd be open to migrating this to some React/Angular/other framework), and the other is a basic React web application.

pros: Strong experience in React web applications matching their requirements.
Solid background in UI/UX improvements and best practices.
Previous work involving JavaScript browser extensions.

description: We are looking for a Senior UI/UX Designer to join our dynamic team and help shape the future of our AI-powered tools.
responsibilities: Collaborate directly in engineering codebases to improve UI/UX.
Redesign existing Edge browser extensions and web applications.
Work closely with product managers and engineers to ensure high-quality user experiences.
qualifications: 5+ years of experience in UI/UX Design.
Proficiency in React and modern JavaScript.
Experience with AI-powered tool interfaces is a plus.
